name: Local Filesystem & Image Tools
description: Give Workspace models scoped tools to list, read, search and rename files, and inspect, resize, convert, rotate or crop images. All operations stay inside a folder you choose for each workspace.

tools.name: list_files
tools.description: List files and folders in the selected workspace directory.

tools.name: read_file
tools.description: Read a UTF-8 text file in the selected workspace directory.

tools.name: write_file
tools.description: Create a new UTF-8 text file without overwriting existing files.

tools.name: list_directory
tools.description: List entries in the selected workspace directory.

tools.name: search_files
tools.description: Find files by name in the selected workspace directory.

tools.name: rename_file
tools.description: Rename or move a file within the selected workspace directory.

tools.name: inspect_image
tools.description: Inspect image dimensions, format and metadata.

tools.name: resize_image
tools.description: Resize an image and save it to a new file.

tools.name: convert_image
tools.description: Convert an image to JPEG, PNG, WebP or AVIF.

tools.name: rotate_image
tools.description: Rotate an image and save it to a new file.

tools.name: crop_image
tools.description: Crop an image by pixel coordinates and save it to a new file.
